CalculatedQuantity.title: CalculatedQuantity

GroundedRecipeVariantDraft.description: Culinary binding input only; nutrition/retail/safety resolution still missing.
GroundedRecipeVariantDraft.title: GroundedRecipeVariantDraft

MutationFixtureDraft.description: Frozen fixture description, not evidence of a running independent validator.
MutationFixtureDraft.title: MutationFixtureDraft

PreparationTransformationFact.description: Net EP_RAW→COOKED yield under Recipe context, not multi-step preparation.
PreparationTransformationFact.title: PreparationTransformationFact

PriceEvidenceAssessmentDraft.description: Optional policy input, not a computed risk score or probability.
PriceEvidenceAssessmentDraft.title: PriceEvidenceAssessmentDraft

PriceObservationFact.description: RetailOffer is a time-bound observation, including CONFIRMED availability.
PriceObservationFact.title: PriceObservationFact

ProcurementSnapshotDraft.description: No scoring/activation claims. rank 0 is primary; positive ranks are backups.
ProcurementSnapshotDraft.title: ProcurementSnapshotDraft

ProductIngredientConversionFact.description:
Future AP inventory handoff MUST retain this mapping, not only ingredient_id.

Not an InventoryLot or validator-ready asset. No persistence/physical ledger here.
ProductIngredientConversionFact.title: ProductIngredientConversionFact

PurchaseIntent.description: A request, never an actual catch-weight checkout quantity.
PurchaseIntent.title: PurchaseIntent

Quantity.description: Stored/source quantity, restricted to NUMERIC(18,6); no implicit rounding.
Quantity.title: Quantity

QuantizationPolicy.description: Caller chooses direction at an explicit storage seam, never a hidden default.
QuantizationPolicy.title: QuantizationPolicy

RecipeVariantRuleFact.description: V1 mass-only substitution; replacement COUNT identity/conversion is deferred.
RecipeVariantRuleFact.title: RecipeVariantRuleFact

ReferencePricePair.description:
Money for a reference AP quantity, NEVER a package/purchase cost.

Future planners need a separate ProcurementCostEvaluator and explicit money
quantization policy. In particular 60,000/1000g is not the cost of a 500g pack.
ReferencePricePair.title: ReferencePricePair

RetailPriceCalibrationFact.description: Adjusts reference baselines only; never multiplies retailer observations.
RetailPriceCalibrationFact.title: RetailPriceCalibrationFact

RetailSourcedAPAssetDraft.description:
Inventory owns this future handoff. AP source evidence must not be discarded.

The old neutral m0 RawIngredientAssetFact is still an incomplete validator draft,
not an accepted retail acquisition handoff. This contract grants no physical stock.
RetailSourcedAPAssetDraft.title: RetailSourcedAPAssetDraft

RetailerStatusProvenance.description: LEGACY_STATE identifies migrated state; it does not invent a reviewed source.
RetailerStatusProvenance.title: RetailerStatusProvenance

SourceCoverageDraft.description:
Structural counts of non-UNAVAILABLE direct evidence, not probabilities.

Multiple references/target stores do not manufacture independent retail evidence.
Single-source remains true if retailer OR provider OR purchasing-path coverage <2.
SourceCoverageDraft.title: SourceCoverageDraft

YieldConversion.description: Yield evidence is contextual. Cooking yield may exceed 1 (e.g. cooked rice).
YieldConversion.title: YieldConversion

description: Bundle of named definitions; select a $defs reference to validate a document. Planner, validation and mutation handoffs are m0 drafts. Retail facts use retail-v2; reference calibration and price pairs remain DRAFT. Recipe authored snapshots use recipe-v1; culinary grounded inputs remain DRAFT. V1 substitutions are mass-only; preparation yield is net and path-specific. No activation-ready inventory or planning handoff is provided. Cross-field semantic guards run in Python, not JSON Schema alone.
title: Menuto M0 domain contracts — draft handoffs, no business HTTP endpoints
